# junghoon_wool_sales

Junghoon78 with the independently tested output-only component from an animal
composition experiment. Original animals and routes remain; wool can be sold at
later egg-sale slots after step266. An egg deposit with carried wool uses DROP.
Fresh source comparison: 968/1,024 wins, mean margin $695; native RNG 240/256.
Generic, typed debug, thread-count, PASS and self-play checks pass. In 32 paired
profiles, wool sells earlier with identical biology, volumes, costs and labor.
Broad tests retain this as a specialist: strong against v4/Mao, weaker against
the public router, teammate and John. It does not replace the main incumbent.
Exact external and local lineage in IMPORT.json.
